# Sign in and restore a protected session without replaying work



## Task kind

Product increment: frontend sign-in/session entry with deterministic domain mocks.

## Workflow status

in_progress — Owner-authorized mock-backed frontend implementation and verification are underway. Current work remains local/uncommitted; acceptance, delivery and closure are pending. Production-only prerequisites and named unresolved slices remain separate.

- Flow 03 (local reviewed source: `_docs/frontend-flows/03-registration.md`), Flow 05 (local reviewed source: `_docs/frontend-flows/05-account-linking.md`), and Flow 15 (local reviewed source: `_docs/frontend-flows/15-account.md`) define adjacent ownership. Approved tokens (local reviewed source: `_docs/frontend-flows/design-tokens.md`) remain normative.

## Increment and context

A visitor can enter a simulated authenticated session and recover the same persisted project screen after expiry, while authentication itself never repeats the operation that required it. Unknown session or provider outcomes remain unknown until reconciled.

## Scope

- Password and Google-entry forms, states, EN/RU feedback, session bootstrap, fixed-expiry simulation, protected-route gating and validated logical destination resolution.
- Identity/session domain mock handlers for existing-account entry, Google return resolution, same-email Google-to-password association, session lookup and operation reconciliation. Consume shared mock persistence/revision infrastructure; do not create another store or facade.
- Safe handoffs to registration, reset and manual linking, including authoritative first-time Google/registration completion results supplied by the registration owner.
- Focused component/contract/browser checks, including no-replay assertions and account-switch privacy.

- Visual composition: Apply cataloged button presentation and explicit input/password derivatives to password and Google entry, session/return resolution and errors in the approved authentication hierarchy. Do not import sample social methods, demo-account claims or example domain behavior.

## Out of scope

- Real OAuth/email/session infrastructure, production token storage/security protocol, identity-policy choices and backend implementation.
- Registration/code completion, manual link mutation, password reset, account deletion and ordinary sign-out orchestration. Account ([#62](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/62)) owns sign-out; recording ([#77](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/77)) owns candidate/lease guards.
- Upload, project creation, quote authorization, spending, purchase fulfillment, capture, recording acceptance or assembly.

## Implementation anchors and invariants

No approved product source file/function is established by this draft. The interrupted `frontend/` scaffold is unapproved; executor must inspect the actual checkout and the accepted runtime/facade before naming implementation paths. Deleted SPEC-002 and historical frontend evidence are not anchors.

React/Zustand views invoke centralized services; client memory is not session, provider proof or canonical-account authority. Unavailable session resolution keeps private content inaccessible without falsely declaring anonymity. Successful sign-in expires at the fixed point 30 days after success, survives browser reopen, never slides with activity and has no Remember-me option. Sign-in validates existing passwords for presence, without imposing registration composition rules. Passwords remain only in the active form lifecycle. Ordinary sign-in opens New dub; valid project reauthentication reconstructs persisted state without command replay.

## Dependencies and ownership

- Depends on: responsive shell/tokens/locale ([#78](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/78)), persistent mock workspace ([#73](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/73)); their runtime/facade prerequisites apply transitively.
- Blocks: registration ([#82](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/82)), reset ([#71](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/71)), linking ([#66](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/66)), Account ([#62](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/62)), Credits ([#65](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/65)), upload ([#81](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/81)), microphone readiness ([#69](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/69)), and browser integration gate ([#63](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/63)).
- Owner: unassigned human/executor. Responsibility: identity/session entry handlers and UI; coordinate shared contract/composition changes with the facade/mock owners. No other task duplicates these handlers.
- Priority: unset.
- Blocking decisions: Flow 02 section 15 provider/security/route details block corresponding real claims. The exact approved route mapping is a slice of contract decisions ([#61](https://github.com/dystrophyless/dubbed.ai/issues/61)). Clarify Flow 15's intended Account return after expiry against Flow 02's stated New dub/project-return defaults before implementing that non-project return; do not invent a general return-URL rule. Production disabled/deleted/rate-limit disclosure and provider mechanics remain service/policy gates. A clearly labelled mock can demonstrate settled transitions without selecting those policies.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] AC-01: Password entry provides success, exact neutral invalid-credential copy, pending, rate-limited/unavailable and recoverable failure states in EN/RU. Pending unverified registration cannot establish a session or trigger a distinct verification-help branch. Fields retain values on active-form failures; secrets never enter durable UI state, URLs, analytics or diagnostics. (F02-AC01/04/10/15.)
- [ ] AC-02: Google outcomes cover linked success, cancellation, denied/failed/stale/unknown return, manual-link-required and method-owned-elsewhere conflict. Only the authoritative same-email result associates Google with the existing password account, preserving account/balance/projects/grant history with no extra proof, settings detour, merge or second grant. First-time registration completion is consumed from its owning handler, without a second implementation. (F02-AC05/06/17/19/22.)
- [ ] AC-03: Resolve sessions before exposing protected facts. The mock preserves the fixed 30-day sign-in anchor across reload/reopen, rejects expiry and non-sliding activity, and reconciles unavailable/unknown outcomes without trusting cached booleans. Ordinary sign-out, other-session revocation and all-session deletion remain separate service outcomes. (F02-AC07/08/18.)
- [ ] AC-04: Ordinary sign-in and the explicit registration-to-sign-in switch open New dub. Valid project reauthentication restores the same persisted screen; missing/unauthorized project context takes the approved safe fallback. No upload, project creation, charge, processing, purchase, deletion, save, capture/acceptance or assembly request is replayed. Unpersisted transient state is not called recovered. Non-project Account-return semantics remain blocked as above. (F02-AC02/03/09/13.)
- [ ] AC-05: Back/Forward/reload, duplicate submit, lost provider return, delayed prior-account result and account switch cannot recreate a completed mutation or expose another account. Reconciliation precedes retry; no password/provider proof is restored. (F02-AC06/07/09/14.)
- [ ] AC-06: Apply shared locale precedence, field-below/service-above errors, accessible show/hide/autofill/paste/Enter/focus/status, the 400px form maximum and approved token/geometry/motion rules at phone/desktop boundaries. Missing font assets or unverified rendering are reported. (F02-AC11/12/15/16/20/21.)
- [ ] AC-07: Evidence identifies every mocked identity/session/link effect as simulation and lists real provider, security, revocation and cross-device proof as unverified. Full Flow 02 closure also requires the Account/recording sign-out integration and final gate, not this isolated task alone. (F02-AC14/18.)

- [ ] AC-VIS-01: Applicable Clean/Light component appearance and states follow the current adoption/token contract with Mabry Pro and shadcn semantics. Cover empty/filled/invalid, password visibility, unavailable session, submitting/loading, provider return conflict and safe service error. Record the exact reference pair/state/value map and explicit derivative/contrast corrections; preserve every functional AC above. Missing required font/source/browser evidence blocks the affected visual claim.

## Verification plan

Not run. After execution authorization, use the runtime task's actual discovered commands; record them rather than inventing a passing command here. Run isolated synthetic accounts and fake service time with no provider calls or real credentials.

1. AC-01/02/05: contract/component matrix for every result; double-activation, callback replay, lost/late return and existing-password/same-email fixtures. Compare canonical IDs, library/balance/grant snapshots and handler call counts; assert no association from typed email equality and no other-account merge.
2. AC-03: resolve anonymous/authenticated/expired/unavailable states; reopen before/at/after fixed expiry, advance fake time through activity/reloads and inspect the unchanged sign-in anchor. Keep private views hidden until successful resolution.
3. AC-04/05: browser expiry at each persisted project screen, invalid/deleted/foreign context and Back/Forward after completion. Spy on every forbidden mutation and require zero replays. Account-return case is explicitly blocked until its contract is clarified.
4. AC-01/06: EN/RU keyboard/password-manager/paste/error cases and locale precedence; inspect browser storage and redacted request diagnostics for secrets. Render at 390/767/768 and representative desktop widths, 200% zoom and reduced motion; measure approved tokens/focus/geometry and separately record actual font loading and assistive-technology results.
5. AC-07: collect scenario IDs, call traces, screenshots and limitations; hand off cross-task sign-out/project-return integration to the final browser gate. Real OAuth/session and cross-device checks belong to the blocked real-adapter follow-up.

Each evidence record includes command/procedure, expected/observed result, environment, date, revision or dirty-worktree boundary, fixture class and artifact location. Proposed checks are not executed evidence.

Visual checks for AC-VIS-01: follow `_docs/frontend-flows/affect-ui-workflow.md`; inspect final actual-browser screenshots against the cataloged Light PNGs and Clean values at desktop, 767/768px and 390px in EN/RU, plus applicable zoom/short-viewport states. Verify loaded Mabry weights/metrics and computed component/native/real-input fonts, including removal of source Inter declarations that would override a global Mabry family; inspect source-mapped geometry, keyboard focus, disabled/loading/error/selected states, dialog behavior where applicable, bounded functional motion and immediate reduced-motion equivalents. Record environment/date/revision or dirty boundary, exact reference paths, expected/actual, screenshots and timing/interaction evidence. No build, token arithmetic, mock state or screenshot capture without inspection substitutes for visual proof.

## Delivery conditions

Deliver locally reviewable frontend behavior and deterministic mocked checks after implementation is separately authorized. This task accepts no real authentication/security claim; package acceptance requires the final browser gate and recorded acceptance source. Commit, push, issue publication, merge and deployment are separately authorized actions, not delivery conditions inferred here.
